metadata.title: When Valorant decided my random click deserved a kill... why tho?
metadata.description:
Didn’t even mean to shoot but hey, enemy down.
They’re probably uninstalling to rethink their life choices.
Click if you’ve ever scored a kill with zero skill!
Watch me act like this was all on purpose for a hot sec.

Hit that if your aim’s broke but the game still hands you freebies!

#valorant #luckshot #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
